# Feature: Echo tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #54 (Echo tile) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: pings the direction of hidden orbs. Unique: gives a direction, never a picture or a reveal. Useful: guides a search while keeping the search itself. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** pings the direction of hidden orbs.

**So that** guides a search while keeping the search itself.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Echo tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-54-echo-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: a room where the echo tile pings toward a hidden orb that lies behind a hazard. A player who walks in the pinged direction in a straight line meets the hazard rather than the orb, which teaches that the ping gives a direction to search in and says nothing about the route. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Standing on it pings an eight-direction indicator toward the nearest hidden orb and is reusable after a few moves
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It gives a direction only, never a picture, so the search stays yours

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It gives a direction only, never a picture, so the search stays yours
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Echo tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-54-echo-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #54.
